content.overview: After the 2018 amendment, specific performance shall be enforced, subject to sections 11(2), 14 and 16.
content.study: Do not argue the old discretionary adequacy-of-damages test as if it were still section 10. The live defences are 14 (not specifically enforceable) and 16 (personal bars, including readiness and willingness).
